Priya (PM): Quick sync 4-week DP beta focused on scope negotiation. Proposal: 5 partners, two priority lanes ("platform" = infra/perf, "app" = UX/quality). Aim: validate rollout lanes and prioritize features.
Gabe (Eng): Sounds good. For "platform" partners we need perf baselines and a dedicated kernel/quant profile. Can we promise the same model family across lanes?
Priya (PM): Prefer same family but different configs (float16 vs int8). That keeps outputs comparable for quality evals.
Theo (ProdOps): Ops: require partner agreement for access windows + a smoke-test 72h before onboarding. Capacity note: reserve 1.5x expected peak per partner for first 2 weeks.
Marta (Design): For "app" lane let's measure time-to-good-response (product-defined) and friction in prompt mapping. We'll make a 1-slide intake that maps use-case -> success metric.
Sam (CS): Customer metrics: onboarding completion, time-to-first-successful-call, and willingness to continue (Y/N). Also recommend weekly 10-min standups for first 3 weeks. Incentive: $300 credit + case study opt-in.
Priya (PM): Launch criteria draft: (1) 4/5 partners complete onboarding within 14 days, (2) median latency p95 under target per lane, (3) no more than 2 actionable regressions flagged by partners.
Gabe (Eng): Implementation items: feature-flag per partner, canary routing, and a fallback to quantized variant. I'll sketch a routing table: ```route_map: {platform: dedicated, app: hosted-canary}```
Theo (ProdOps): Add an abort condition: if overall GPU utilization > 85% for >30min, throttle new partners and notify on-call.
Marta (Design): Feedback loop: 1) weekly micro-survey (3 q), 2) in-product report button, 3) end-of-cohort retrospective interview. I'll produce survey copy.
Sam (CS): Escalation play: partner -> CS -> eng on-call -> weekly exec sync if unresolved. SLA: initial ack <2h for sev1 during onboarding.
RecruitBot: Added recruitment sheet link: https://redwood.example.com/sheets/dp-beta-scope. Please add candidate notes.
Priya (PM): Action list: Gabe = routing/fallback matrix, Theo = infra reserve + abort rules, Marta = intake slide + survey, Sam = incentive + cadence doc. Reconvene Mon 9am. Any objections?
Gabe (Eng): No objections. I'll post matrix by EOD Fri.
Theo (ProdOps): I'll confirm reserve numbers and pre-onboard checklist.
Marta (Design): I'll drop the intake slide and survey draft in #product.
Sam (CS): I'll line up 5 prospects with Sales and draft the incentive terms.
Priya (PM): Thanks team. One negotiation note: we should keep scope flexible — if a partner requests an out-of-scope infra integration, we'll treat as separate engagement. Tag those requests as "scope-change" in the intake sheet.
